name: Unpivot
description: Stacks the selected columns into a name/value pair using DuckDB UNPIVOT. Columns that are not selected are kept; the selected columns must share one type. Rows whose selected value is NULL are dropped by DuckDB UNPIVOT.

columns.title: Columns
columns.description: Columns to stack into name/value rows.

nameColumn.title: Name column
nameColumn.description: Name of the column holding the source column names.

valueColumn.title: Value column
valueColumn.description: Name of the column holding the stacked values.
